name: Youth Volunteer Corps
what_you_do: Sign up for team service projects posted online and log your volunteer hours. The city says the projects teach life and work skills.
who_can_apply: Youth. The program page does not state an age or grade rule.
pay_detail: Volunteer program. Pay is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. The page calls the program new and gives no dates.
how_to_apply: Use the Sign Up Here link on the program page. It opens the YDAT volunteer site for Billings. Make an account, then sign up for projects. A parent can set up a profile for each child. Phone: 406-657-8371.
notes: The program page does not list ages, dates or hour rules. Call the parks office to ask what ages can join.
